text: 中欧贸易投资磋商机制第二次例会成果共识清单：双方赞同提升全球产业链供应链可预期性与稳定性的重要性
text_en: List of consensus outcomes from the second regular meeting of the China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation Mechanism: Both sides agree on the importance of enhancing the predictability and stability of global industrial and supply chains
